about.para1: This application was built to provide amusement.
about.para2: It plays a recorded phrase through a tremolo effect, then the curtains part to reveal the result.
about.builtWith: Built with React, Daisy UI, and the Tuna audio effects library.

help.step1: Press the button under the curtains to play the sound.
help.step2: Wait for the recording to finish. The curtains will open on their own.
help.step3: Your computer will then announce that it is done.
help.step4: Use the Settings page to change the theme, language, voice, and tremolo effect.
help.tip: If you hear nothing, check that your device is not muted and that the page is allowed to play sound.
